parameters.name: Cycle
parameters.description: The cycle based on which queries are performed.

parameters.name: Locale
parameters.description:
The identifier of the language.

Valid values:

*   EN: English.
*   ZH: Chinese.

parameters.name: ModuleCode
parameters.description: The code of the pricing module.

parameters.name: PageNum
parameters.description: The number of the page to return.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: The number of entries to return on each page.

parameters.name: PayMode
parameters.description: The payment mode. Valid values: total: all upfront. half: half upfront. zero: no upfront.

parameters.name: SpnType
parameters.description: The type of the savings plan. Valid values: ecs: Elastic Compute Service (ECS) compute type. universal: general-purpose type.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun bssopenapi query-savings-plans-discount --module-code instance_type --pay-mode total --page-size 20 --spn-type universal --locale ZH --cycle 1:Year --page-num 1 --spec ecs.g6 --commodity-code ecs --biz-region cn-hangzhou --spn-commodity-code savingplan_common_public_cn --api-version 2017-12-14 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun bssopenapi QuerySavingsPlansDiscount --region cn-hangzhou --Locale ZH --SpnType universal --SpnCommodityCode savingplan_common_public_cn --PageSize 20 --PageNum 1 --ModuleCode instance_type --CommodityCode ecs --Region 'cn-hangzhou' --Spec 'ecs.g6' --PayMode total --Cycle '1:Year'
